registryInstallation: Fresh project extracted from the locally built production developer site
databaseCheck: Real HTTP, two respondents, denied edits, revision conflicts, required answers and reload from disk after restart
recordedWorkflow: Author a template, edit instructions, add a field and repeat a rich answer. Issue a private link, edit the original, save and reopen the respondent draft, submit, review the captured revision, export JSON, reopen the template into a separate workspace.

invitationAccess.workflow: Revoke a named link while a respondent edits a private draft. Its next save and reload are denied. A second independent link still saves and reopens. Revoke a submitted link and retain the author review.
invitationAccess.migration: Opened a database created with the earlier schema, recovered the saved draft and revoked the existing link.
